specimen_label: Abdominal wall and pelvic floor model
transcribed_question: A) What level is the section point A given out? B) Identify the structure point B

marker.description: A white paper tag labelled 'A' is attached to the upper abdominal wall near the xiphoid process.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the tag labelled 'A'.
main_explanation: The tag is attached to the inferior tip of the sternum, which is the xiphisternum (xiphoid process).

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located immediately posterior to the xiphisternum?
supporting_question.explanation: The central tendon of the diaphragm is attached to the posterior surface of the xiphisternum.
